pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bxh7+ from a bishop on b3 that cannot reach h7; plan 2 called the half-open c-file open and had ...Rxc3 through the c6-knight. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, Old Main Line, 12.h4 Ne5 13.Kb1 Nc4
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's Bxc4 as a Black move and plan 1 had ...Rxc3 before the c-file is clear. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 around Bxc4 Rxc4; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Scheveningen Variation, Fianchetto Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight via f1-e3; plan 4 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Scheveningen Variation, Vitolins Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...b5 with White's bishop on b5 and called it a minority attack. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, English Attack, 7...b5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and an ...a5-a4 route. Rewrote plan 2 around ...Bb7, ...Nbd7 and ...b4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, English, 7...b5 8.Qd2 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 3 had a knight route Na1-b3. Rewrote plan 3 around Nce2 or Na4 against ...b4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Fianchetto Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Bb7 with the bishop on d7. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Vitolins, 6...Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route with White's bishop on b5. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Keres, 6...h6 7.h4 Nc6 8.Rg1 h5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Qe1-g3 route through the f2-pawn; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both plans around 9.gxh5 and the g-file.

pages.name: Sicilian: Scheveningen, Keres, 6...Nc6 7.g5 Nd7 8.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the d7-knight to f8 and b6 "to pressure c4". Rewrote plan 4.
